title: Got to channel my inner @Bekah from Baltimore and see a regional POTU...
transcript: Once again, driving 90 minutes to go rush a show. That would be me. Now I'm headed to Curious Theatre Company, and they don't have a normal rush. They have a industry rush for people that work in the theater industry. And so, uh, I am bringing an old headshot and resume. Uh, there we go. This is a horrible headshot. I, I love theater, but I cannot believe I'm making this drive up to Denver for the third time this week. Anyway, uh, let's go to the theater. POTUS is the first show in the new Curious Theater Company's season, and their season is staff with so many plays that I love, but I was definitely really excited to see POTUS again. I first saw this show on Broadway. It was absolutely hilarious, and I was really excited to see a regional production of it, especially after hearing Becca from Baltimore talk about her experience on the POTUS trail. Curious Theatre Company is definitely a smaller theatre. You could feel that, especially in the scenic design. Some of the transitions were really rough, but it was worth it all for this incredibly funny script and the absolutely hilarious performances, especially the hilarious Leslie O'carroll as Stephanie the secretary. POTUS is currently playing at Curious Theatre Company through October 13th.
classificationReason: Creator attended and reviewed a regional production of POTUS at Curious Theatre Company, but this specific production is not in the provided list of Broadway/West End shows
